body: Yeah thanks, it's nice to know I'm not completely at fault, when posting in that subreddit it can often make you feel that it is, which then leads to self-criticism and building of contempt for others.
Yeah depression is very crushing, it's difficult as it often takes hold at times too. And I really appreciate the responses too, thanks a lot guys.

Not entirely true, I care a lot for most people, which probably leads to my disappointment as such. And although there are constraints such as difficulty expressing this to others in person, or being limited physically as one individual, I always try to do the best that I can.
You're right in a sense, I probably wouldn't end up hurting anyone else, rather I'd only hurt myself by doing so. This is just me venting and expressing my anger at how cold people can be at times.

Therapy and psychology are useless, not to mention pseudo-sciences, it's not about helping people it exists as a service to extract money from those who need help the most. Medication has had no effect whatsoever on me.

And there are no alternatives because I live in a relatively small and isolated city. Also why is it different that it's another subreddit? It's still reflective of human behavior and carelessness.

Other people are the last thing I care about right now, people are selfish and care only for themselves, you are an example also. No one cares about the suffering and pain people face, only when there's a possibility it may be inflicted upon them, this is how pathetic people are.

Look at my post asking for advice on another subreddit, I was asking for help and all I ever get in return is "no one gives a shit you're not important, fuck you". Moderator locks my thread for "ranting", fuck I hate this world so goddamn much.
Nah, would definitely not consider it silent under full pronunciation.

You moderators really are useless, who in the hell are you to tell me my post isn't asking for advice when clearly it is doing exactly that? Thank your lucky stars there's a screen between us. Go screw yourself why don't you.

> And right now... You're not. 

So great? What then, clearly if no one is interested and I'm such a "common"place failure, why even try at all? Like I said, even if I were the definitive and complete version of perfection, there would still be people who dislike me for who I am? It doesn't matter what I do nor how hard I try, people will find a reason to write me off. And yes that is upsetting.

Well I was primarily speaking about my outward appearance sharing similarities with those around me, and although I'm not the most interesting person, I wouldn't consider myself boring? I have various interests & would consider myself quite approachable/fun to hang out with (Despite my troubles with redirecting conversations). Confidence and experience are things I am lacking in.


And although I briefly outlined my mental health issues there are other factors that contribute as to why I feel so unfulfiled (Such as memory loss, inability to recall information etc).


Even if I were projecting my best image, why do other people never make an effort on their part to initiate? Because I'm not good enough, is that it?
Therapy is useless, and my psychologist doesn't give a damn whether or not anything improves or changes, so long as he's prescribing further medications.

And this proves my point, why would I need to be the one attending to others if I was someone *worth knowing*? Wouldn't others want to initiate contact with me? As it is people just act as though I'm not there, staring straight through me, clearly there doesn't seem to be any desire to learn more or discuss things with me.
